title: Peruvian Crispy Fried Fish Bites
description: A crispy, gluten-free Peruvian-style fried fish bites recipe with a hint of garlic.
instructions: Cut fish into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together breadcrumbs and crumble.
In a separate shallow dish, beat the egg.
Dip each fish piece into the egg, then coat in breadcrumb mixture.
Heat about 1/2-inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When oil is hot, add coated fish pieces and fry until golden brown.
Flip and fry the other side.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lime and a sprinkle of garlic.
